source.prompt: A flat, front-on decorative panel, square, 2048x2048, on a solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff). Orthographic, flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The pattern must repeat: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Pre-Cataclysm Ancient metal honeycomb visor and porthole grille, a precision lattice of bevelled flat gunmetal-grey bars (#6e7074 to #8a8a8a) forming regular hexagonal apertures (ten hexagons across the frame) with slight edge wear and fine machining grain; every hexagonal opening shows only the solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff) through it. Hard clean edges against the magenta (#ff00ff), no anti-aliased fringe of other colours. No magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the subject.
